name: codex-context-window
description: Inject current Codex context-window usage through lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex aware of its context-window usage.
interface.longDescription: Uses bundled native binaries to read the latest token-count event from the current local Codex session file and inject a compact usage marker at supported lifecycle points.
defaultPrompt: Show my current Codex context-window usage.
